summary: Dream Execution's long-running free-to-play tactical and vehicular shooter.

entries.title: War Rock

emulation.notes: The game requires the current Windows client, third-party account, anti-cheat, and live servers.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current native PC client at its maximum supported settings.

primary.version: Current Papaya Play international client, preferably through Steam
primary.why: War Rock is a server-dependent free-to-play game. The Papaya Play client is the currently supported international service, and Steam provides the most straightforward install route while using the same Papaya account/service.
primary.how_to_play: Install the current Steam client, create or link the required Papaya Play account, choose the active international region, and record the client version, server, mode, map rotation, monetization state, and event date.

all_releases.reason: skip for an international archive run: separate regional service and account history.

all_releases.fidelity: Original international launch under earlier publishers.
all_releases.reason: skip: those historical service states are no longer the current playable build.

all_releases.fidelity: Current international live-service client and servers.
all_releases.reason: primary: the supported way to access the evolving game today.

all_releases.fidelity: Current storefront install for the Papaya Play service.
all_releases.reason: primary: easiest current installation and account-link route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The current client is the only practical playable route, but it cannot reproduce every retired map rotation, balance state, publisher era, or monetization state from the long-running service.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a changing live service, not a fixed remaster. Archive the exact date, version, server region, map, mode, available equipment, and event state; older builds are not a supported fallback.
